response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_conf FROM compliancecase GROUP BY brokrepstat), b AS (SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS base FROM compliancecase), q AS (SELECT g.brokrepstat, g.avg_conf, b.base FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.avg_conf > b.base), m AS (SELECT AVG(avg_conf) AS mean_q FROM q) SELECT q.brokrepstat, q.avg_conf AS avg_modelconf, q.avg_conf - q.base AS diff_from_baseline, q.avg_conf / m.mean_q AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean FROM q CROSS JOIN m WHERE q.base IS NOT NULL AND m.mean_q IS NOT NULL

assumptions.assumption: The baseline is the plain average of modelconf over all cases (NULL modelconf ignored), so it is weighted by case count. The divisor in the ratio is the unweighted mean of the qualifying statuses' averages, as the request says.
Cases with NULL brokrepstat form one group, which GROUP BY produces naturally. Its status is shown as NULL.
